newsitem.title: ITALY: Bank of Italy okays San Paolo purchase.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Italy okays San Paolo purchase.

text.p: The Bank of Italy gave the go-ahead for San Paolo to acquire a leasing company, Arpac Leasing Spa, and for Banca Popolare dell'Etruria e del Lazio to buy Banca Popolare di Roma, the anti-trust authority said.
The authority said in its weekly bulletin it too had given its stamp of approval to the deals.
San Paolo, currently engaged in a global privatisation offering, intends to acquire Arpac -- which specialises in car-leasing -- outright through its leasing arm San Paolo Leasing Spa.
Popolare dell'Etruria planned to acquire at least 75 percent of Popolare di Roma through a share bid, the bulletin said.
